section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the implications for clinical practice, focusing on how professionals can help caregivers understand the link between their messages about eating, weight, and relationships and their daughters' self-perception and body trust. It also encourages therapists to incorporate interventions to help women respect and appreciate their bodies, suggesting strategies like setting realistic goals, capitalizing on body assets, surrounding themselves with supportive individuals, being mindful of body needs, and challenging media images.
